_source: Gardner blastocyst grading criteria (Gardner & Schoolcraft 1999; Gardner et al. 2000, Fertil Steril, doi:10.1016/S0015-0282(00)00518-5). Codes as in labels.csv: EXP 0-4 = grade 1-5; ICM/TE 0/1/2 = A/B/C.
_usage: Class prompt = template.format(phrase); for ICM/TE the phrase is 'a blastocyst in which ' + clause. Pseudo-captions combine one EXP phrase with ICM/TE clauses (or the ND sentence for EXP grade 1-2).

0: an early blastocyst whose blastocoel cavity fills less than half of the embryo
an early blastocyst with a small fluid-filled cavity, Gardner expansion grade 1
an embryo at the start of blastulation with a small blastocoel
1: a blastocyst whose blastocoel cavity fills at least half of the embryo
a blastocyst of Gardner expansion grade 2 with a growing blastocoel
a blastocyst whose cavity occupies half or more of the embryo volume
2: a full blastocyst whose blastocoel cavity completely fills the embryo
a full blastocyst of Gardner expansion grade 3 with a zona pellucida that has not yet thinned
a full blastocyst with the blastocoel filling the whole embryo
3: an expanded blastocyst whose blastocoel is larger than the early embryo and whose zona pellucida is thinning
an expanded blastocyst of Gardner grade 4 with a thin zona pellucida
an expanded blastocyst with an enlarged cavity stretching the zona pellucida
4: a hatching blastocyst whose trophectoderm is herniating through the zona pellucida
a hatching blastocyst of Gardner grade 5 with cells emerging through the zona pellucida
a blastocyst that has started to hatch from the zona pellucida

0: the inner cell mass is tightly packed with many cells
the inner cell mass is grade A, prominent and compact with many cells
a large, compact inner cell mass of many cells is visible
1: the inner cell mass is loosely grouped with several cells
the inner cell mass is grade B, with several loosely grouped cells
the inner cell mass is less compact, containing several cells
2: the inner cell mass contains very few cells
the inner cell mass is grade C, with very few cells
the inner cell mass is poorly defined with very few cells

0: the trophectoderm has many cells forming a cohesive epithelium
the trophectoderm is grade A, a tight continuous layer of many cells
many small trophectoderm cells form a cohesive layer
1: the trophectoderm has few cells forming a loose epithelium
the trophectoderm is grade B, a loose layer of few cells
the trophectoderm is formed by fewer cells in a loosely connected layer
2: the trophectoderm has very few large cells
the trophectoderm is grade C, with very few large cells
the trophectoderm consists of only a few large cells

ND: the inner cell mass and trophectoderm are not yet distinguishable
the inner cell mass and trophectoderm cannot be graded at this stage
the cell lineages are not yet clearly separated
